$comment: Sample manifest for trying the extension and for Chrome Web Store reviewers. Not a real app, and it covers only the screens the extension fills, so avow check reports the rest as missing.

app_access.why: No login; every screen is reachable without an account.

advertising_id.why: AD_ID is absent from the merged release manifest.

target_audience.why: General-audience utility; under-13 groups left unticked to stay out of the Families programme.

data_safety.why: Crash reports only, sent over HTTPS to our own endpoint.
